§c§lOps appendix — nothing here touches player progression.§r This volume is all about the cat's own things: the machine's trade entries, sign-in rewards and lottery pools, every one of them admin-customizable.

The cat recommends the §3visual edit mode§r: flip §3/gtit nekovm edit on§r and edit trade-group entries right inside the vending machine GUI — what you see is what you get, and §2/gtit nekovm reload§r makes it live in a second.

Traditional command folks are not stopped either: the /gtit command family and the configs under §3§nconfig/gtit§r are all there; hand-writing JSON is your freedom. Quest gating accepts §3§nhigh:low§r, UUID or Base64. This line is an optional detour — skipping it costs nothing. §8§oThe cat does not care about your means, only that the shelves look good.§r
